With polls still open in 48 states, prediction markets have increased their odds of Democrats wresting control of Congress.
As of 630p ET, Kalshi put the odds at 82%, up from 77% Tuesday morning. Polymarket's odds are 85%, up from 75%.
Both predictions markets see a Democrat takeover of the House as almost certain. Kalshi's odds are 96%; Polymarket's, 98%.
For the Senate, Kalshi sees a Democratic flip at 83%. Polymarket's odds are 86%.
Most polling sites in Kentucky and Indiana closed at 6p. Some are still open in areas located in the Central Time Zone.
At 7p, polls will close in Florida, Georgia, New Hampshire, South Carolina, Vermont, and Virginia.
Seeking Alpha will have continuing coverage of the midterm elections through the evening.

title: Democrat takeover of Congress seen more likely by prediction markets
